analyst.text: The defending champion Knicks open a five-game homestand, while Portland are on game five of a six-game road trip right after Damian Lillard's emotional 33-point return to Milwaukee. The Blazers are still without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe, Deni Avdija is questionable, and they have lost seven straight to New York. The angle leans towards New York.
